headline: Cocktail explodes near PM's Office in Tejgaon late night, no casualties reported
summary: Miscreants on a motorcycle detonated a cocktail in front of the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka, late Friday night. No casualties were reported, but an unexploded device was later defused.
details: Miscreants detonated a cocktail in front of the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, Dhaka, around 1:15 AM on Friday night. Two individuals on a motorcycle carried out the attack before fleeing the scene.
Police confirmed that there were no casualties or injuries from the explosion. They also recovered an unexploded cocktail from the site shortly after the incident.

The unexploded device was successfully defused by the police bomb disposal unit around 2:30 AM. Authorities have since increased security measures around the Prime Minister's Office, including controlling vehicle movement.
Police are actively working to identify and apprehend the two miscreants involved in the incident. Investigations are ongoing to determine the motive behind the late-night explosion.

The unexploded device was successfully defused by the police bomb disposal unit around 2:30 AM. Authorities have since increased security measures around the Prime Minister's Office, including controlling vehicle movement.

Police are actively working to identify and apprehend the two miscreants involved in the incident. Investigations are ongoing to determine the motive behind the late-night explosion.

headline_marked: [[bKash manager shot]], Tk 3 crore looted in Sreepur, Gazipur
headline: bKash manager shot, Tk 3 crore looted in Sreepur, Gazipur
summary: A bKash cash manager was shot in the stomach and three other employees were assaulted during a robbery in Sreepur, Gazipur. Approximately Tk 2.5-3 crore was stolen by 15-20 motorcyclists.
details: A bKash cash manager was shot and nearly Tk 3 crore was looted in Sreepur, Gazipur, on Friday evening. The incident occurred around 6:30 PM in the Karnapur area of the Sreepur-Gosinga regional road.

The injured manager, Himel (35), is the Accounts Manager for Valuka Channel Enterprise. Three other employees – Md Fahad Hossain (30), Rifath (20), and driver Lal Mia (25) – were also assaulted during the attack.

The bKash employees were transporting Tk 3 crore, collected from various agents in Narsingdi, in three bags in a private car towards Maona. As their car reached a secluded, forested area in Karnapur, 15 to 20 unknown assailants on motorcycles intercepted them.

The robbers broke the car's windows, shot Himel in the stomach, dragged him out, and severely beat the other staff and the driver. They then fled with two bags containing an estimated Tk 2.5 crore from the car's trunk.

Following the incident, locals assisted the injured in reaching the Upazila Health Complex. Dr. Anik Sarkar of Sreepur Upazila Health Complex stated that Himel, due to his gunshot wound, was urgently transferred to Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College Hospital in Gazipur, while others received first aid.

Sreepur Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mohammad Shahinur Alam reported that bKash had not informed the police or 999 about transporting such a large sum of money, nor had they requested police security. Police have been dispatched to the scene, and legal action is being taken as the investigation proceeds.
